title: Cross-SDK retry contract and streaming ergonomics for embeddings & reranking with batched cursor examples
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Deliver a consistent retry semantics and streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs for the embeddings and reranking endpoints, plus a set of batched cursor-based examples that demonstrate pagination, efficient batching, and graceful retry behavior. Work includes API design, cross-language implementations, test coverage, migration notes, and example applications. Key concerns: idempotency/duplication risk for rerank operations, backpressure in streaming flows, per-language ergonomics (async iterators in Python/TS, channels in Go), and clear docs for customers to adopt batched pagination to reduce token and VM overhead.
acceptance_criteria: Unified public retry contract documented and implemented in Python/TS/Go
Streaming ergonomics provided per language: async iterator for Python, AsyncIterable/ReadableStream for TypeScript, channel/ctx-aware stream for Go
Batched cursor helper that yields batches of inputs and accepts resume cursors is available in each SDK
Examples repo updated with 3 end-to-end samples (python, ts, go) showing embeddings+rerank pagination and retry semantics
Integration tests for retries, idempotency, and resumed pagination added to CI
Docs + migration guide published in SDK docs and linked from API reference
tasks: Draft API contract and public method signatures for each SDK
Prototype streaming helper for Python (async generator with backpressure)
Implement Go helper (context-aware channel and backpressure semantics)
Add idempotency token support and server-side correlation notes to docs
Write unit + integration tests for pagination resume and retry scenarios
Update SDK CHANGELOGs and migration guide
Gather API review and security review signoff
